disclosures: This run co-authored the increment (it resumed and repaired the WIP), so it is not an independent review.
No starter list is certified; Ayula still has 6 missing names and the eight-list gate remains 1 of 8.
The journey is a 40-card package, not a 100-card certificate, and not AI strength evidence.
The 104 Clue tokens versus 14 exiles is the printed behaviour with several Witnesses out: each one triggers per qualifying death, and only the first exile finds the card still in the graveyard.
A commander that dies alone in combat and is put into the command zone is a new object (CR 400.7), so the trigger finds nothing to exile there and still investigates.

The six remaining Ayula names are heavy new mechanics; their authoritative sources are preserved in slice46/sources/ from the previous run.
Reviewer artifacts from earlier rounds remain untracked and were not republished.
